name: Wind tunnel (GPU CFD)
summary: A virtual wind tunnel for car models: lattice-Boltzmann LES on the GPU (NVIDIA Warp) gives drag, lift, surface pressure, streamlines and flow slices for each STL/OBJ/GLB car.
help: Wire car models (STL, OBJ, GLB/glTF, PLY, OFF; one car per file) into Car models, for example from a Dataset block. Each car is scaled (units detected or set), turned so its length runs along the wind and its wheels stand on the road, voxelized and simulated in turn: D3Q19 lattice Boltzmann with a regularized collision and a Smagorinsky LES model, a partial-slip wall model on the body, slip floor (like a rolling road), velocity inlet, pressure outlet with a sponge. Forces come from momentum exchange, averaged over the last part of the run. With no files wired (or Sample cars set), built-in parametric cars are used: fastback, notchback, estate, suv, pickup, van, sports, and the ahmed25 reference body. Outputs: the View's files (*.tunnel.json.gz: the car's surface with pressure, streamlines, slices, history), results.csv (Cd, Cl, Cs, CdA, drag, lift, power at the speed), convergence.csv, surfaces coloured by Cp (PLY with a cp property), the sample cars as STL and a report. Live telemetry channel tunnel: model, time, running Cd and the centre-plane flow. Resolution is cells per car length: 96 is about 6 M cells and a minute per car on an RTX 3070 / V100.

inputs.label: Car models
inputs.help: One car per file; the length along X with the nose at the smallest X and Z up by default (see the settings)

outputs.label: Results
outputs.help: results.csv: one row per car: Cd, Cl, Cs, frontal area, CdA, drag, lift, drag power

outputs.label: Convergence
outputs.help: convergence.csv: model, t (flow-through times), cd, cl

outputs.label: Pressure surfaces
outputs.help: <model>_cp.ply: the surface coloured by Cp, with a cp vertex property

outputs.label: Sample cars
outputs.help: The built-in cars used, as STL

params.label: Sample cars
params.help: auto: the four samples when no files are wired; or a list: fastback, notchback, estate, suv, pickup, van, sports, ahmed25; all; none

params.label: Flow-through times
params.help: How long each car is simulated, in car lengths of air passing by; the last ~55% is averaged

params.label: Nose at
params.help: Whether the front of the car is at the smallest or the largest coordinate of the length axis
